chapter_title: Concerning the Seed Grain that shall be formed by the Elements, and also be destroyed by them
chapter_note: After a brief hagiographic dialogue header, the chapter is largely a compact cosmological teaching using the seed-grain/tree as a correspondential image for elemental formation and blight in the mixture. One paragraph (¶3) pivots from cosmic description to ecclesial actors (“teachers and the elect”), indicating a later institutional application grafted onto an older correspondential line.

paragraphs.temporal_note: Hagiographic/dialogue apparatus: “apostle”, “builder of the church”, and the setting “speaks to his disciples” are compilation-frame markers.

paragraphs.core_text: “This seed grain and this barley grain that you see shall be formed and [...] and beautified by the five elements. Now, the warmth and the cold nourish the seed grain and the entire tree. So, just as these things nourish it [...] it is destroyed [...] through [...] hunger.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Impersonal process-teaching: elements as formative/nourishing agencies and the same system as destructive agency; cosmos→cosmos mapping (elements ↔ growth/decay) without institutional address.

paragraphs.core_text: “In this way also Righteousness gathers the five to it.
paragraphs.removed_material: Removed the institutional application that maps the process onto church roles: “chosen by the teachers and the elect; and they gather it in and ornament it ... Now, just as they that shall enlighten ...” This crosses from cosmic mechanism to contemporary community actors.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Begins in the same systemic explanatory voice (“Righteousness gathers the five”), then pivots to ecclesial-identificatory language (“teachers and the elect”), indicating later pastoral/application use of the correspondence.

paragraphs.core_text: “In this way too, a lack and a shortfall shall occur from place to place through them; and they who have chosen it have gathered it in and beautified and attained it, while an affliction shall arise for it through those.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Continues the impersonal cycle logic (gain here implies deprivation elsewhere; affliction arising through the same agencies). No explicit institutional vocabulary; reads as a systemic consequence within the world of mixture (though the pronouns could be read as continuing the prior application).

paragraphs.core_text: “People also shall be caused to stumble on their account, through the energy of Matter that dwells in them. It has poured its shadow over them, just as it shall also pour its shadow over the elements and destroy the fruits of all the trees.”
paragraphs.temporal_note: Cosmological agency language: Matter as an indwelling force with causal efficacy (“poured its shadow”), applied consistently to humans and elements within the same mythic-physical system (cosmos→cosmos mechanism, not exhortation or citation).
